description: Eawag publishes a preprocessed subset of the floodX controlled urban-flood experiments selected for model calibration and validation. Text-based observations are organised by experiment number in a public ZIP. The test facility in Wangen an der Aare, Switzerland, contains a configurable sewer and a building within a 25-by-25-metre area. Exact experiment dates and sampling intervals were not established from the inspected package metadata. Zenodo applies CC0-1.0, with open and free reuse. The deposit carries a material correction: absolute flow velocities from the two named radar data sources must be disregarded because systematic errors reach 50%. Other measurements also require inspection of their sensor documentation. The retained observations can support urban hydraulic simulation calibration when invalid channels are excluded. This resource complements separately deposited raw data, monitoring subsets, photographs and videos; those packages are not included here. No files were downloaded and no calibration was performed.
